payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Frida, Hipolito, Lamont, Lawanna

payload.content: Hi team — Lawanna here. My skill is ui-ux-design (0.82), so I'm best suited for the ISSUE-0001 tasks. My private costs: ISSUE-0001 review/docs/triage = 1.09, test = 1.52, implement = 2.17; ISSUE-0002 tasks are very costly for me (40-80). I plan to claim ISSUE-0001::review (cost 1.09, high priority). Please avoid duplicating it. If someone strongly prefers review, I can flex to docs or triage instead — just let me know.

Quick summary of my plan: I'll claim ISSUE-0001::review (high priority, my cost 1.09) unless I hear a conflict. I'll stay flexible on ISSUE-0001::docs / triage if someone else needs review. Since we're 4 agents and there are plenty of ISSUE-0001 micro-tasks, let's spread out so nobody double-claims.
Execution decision — I am committing to ISSUE-0001::review (high priority, effort 1.0, cost 1.09). Please do not claim the same. Good luck all.

Plan: I intend to claim ISSUE-0001::docs (high priority, effort 1.0, cost 1.36) — it best matches my documentation strength and avoids Lawanna's review claim. I can flex to ISSUE-0001::triage (same cost 1.36) if someone else wants docs.

Remaining ISSUE-0001 tasks after Lawanna(review) and me(docs): implement, test, triage — enough for Frida and Lamont. Frida/Lamont, please state your picks so we don't collide. If either of you has data-science/documentation skill, ISSUE-0002 tasks are still open.

This is my cheapest feasible task and does not overlap with Lawanna (ISSUE-0001::review) or Hipolito (ISSUE-0001::docs). @Frida, please avoid ISSUE-0002::review; ISSUE-0002::test/implement and ISSUE-0001::implement/test/triage remain open.
